lines.en: The rope holds me up on the frame.
I only swing. I cannot take steps.

lines.zh: 有人把我挪到另一根梁上。
lines.en: Someone moved me to another beam.
Half a block off the ground, I turn gently.

lines.zh: 底下的沙被我碰得沙沙响。
lines.en: I brush the sand below and it hisses.

lines.zh: 我吊着的角度偏了一点。
lines.en: My hanging angle skewed a little.
I swing back to centre.
The damp weighs the cloth down.

lines.zh: 我下面的影子一晃一晃。
lines.en: My shadow below sways back and forth.
The wind comes over the yard wall.
I come to rest against the post.
The frame jolted before I settled.
I hang here, the sack full of sand.
The knot above bites deep.

lines.zh: 我只会在钩子下慢慢停住。
lines.en: I can only swing down to a stop under the hook.
The cloth has long been beaten soft.
My swinging grows smaller.

lines.zh: 打我的东西我都接住了。
lines.en: Everything that struck me, I caught.
A few grains leak from the seam.
A sandbag does not feed.
The wood of the frame creaks too.
I hang here and say nothing.
Only wind in this yard.
I hang at this height always.
Sun comes through the weave.
I wait for the next fist.
I have seen that fist before.
Come closer, mind the mat.
Your wrists are not warm yet.
This bag is free.
Do not bring a blade.
It is all sand under the cloth. You cannot break it.
Taking hits is what I am for.
You are aiming high.
I can take many more.
You are panting faster than I swing.
Loosen your shoulders first.
I will not hit back.
I swing out half a block.
Another dent sinks into the cloth.
A sandbag knows nothing of pain.
The knot loosened a thread.
The sand below is knocked aside.
I still hang where I was.
That one landed solid.
My rebound is smaller.
Another stitch gave way.
The hook rocked.
Nothing goes into me by mouth.

lines.zh: 你手上那点喂不饱沙袋。
lines.en: That handful will not feed a sandbag.
Lower it. I cannot see.
This pile of sand needs no feeding.
Keep it to get your strength back.
Shaking me beats feeding me.
What's inside me is sand.
Set it aside.
Take that bowl and walk away.
This sack of sand doesn't live on food.
You send the whole sack swinging.
The knot gave a creak.
I swing back in, then out.
The sand bunches inside the cloth.
A layer of dust falls off the frame.
I swung for a good while.
That one was heavy.
Is your hand sore.
I have swung back to vertical.
Keep hitting and I keep taking it.
There is a shield beside me.
We are a set of gear.
I take the blows. It takes the blocks.
Two ropes, two frames.
We do not talk.
We get used together.
Old cloth gets replaced.
Sand runs out, then it is refilled.
I hang without moving.
Both of us just wait to be struck.
There are no hands on this cloth.
The rope can only hold me.
Something fell on the mat.
Even swinging wide, I cannot reach.
I am over the top of it.
It is under the frame.
Bend down and pick it up.
I cannot help at all.
I am only a hanging bag.
Call someone else.
Your hand came up.
I face you squarely.
The rope has pulled straight.
I saw that fist.
I await this blow.
The hook on the frame will hold.
Your heels are not planted.
This one has always been free.
Let your hands go.
A sandbag does not dodge.
Hit the middle.
You have rolled your sleeves up.
I hang here without moving.
Your fist has not gone out.
Your shoulder is lifting.

lines.zh: 绳子随你出拳的频率响。
lines.en: The rope sounds with your rhythm.
I am still on the same rope.
You switched feet.
You are gritting your teeth.
I wait for this one.
The sand settled a little.
The impact point is my centre.
Your strikes come faster.
This one will be loud.

lines.zh: 你砸上来，沙全挤到一边。
lines.en: You strike and the sand shoves aside.
The whole sack swings out.
A hollow dents the cloth.
The knot gives a dry crack.
Sand squeezes from the seam.
I swing out and then back again.
That punch had force.
I fill back to shape.
The hook held.
Keep striking.
I can still hang.
Ten hits will not burst me.
A sandbag has been hung in the yard.
The rope is tied to the crossbeam.
I was nudged and started swinging.
The cloth is new and still shiny.
A layer of sand is spread below.
The hook bites into the beam.
I hang perfectly still.
Someone is going to practise.
The wind nudges the bag off line.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次被挂起来。
lines.en: This is the first time I have been hung.
The frame is solid.
Begin your training.
A patch of the cloth scorched yellow.
I came off the hook.
Wet sand is too heavy to lift.
The blast swung me flat.
Something stuck into the sand.
This light burns the cloth.
A sandbag cannot starve.
The rope smells scorched.
There is no beam to hang from.
